verdict.rationale: Jira's own marketing pages say users can create custom automation rules that move work forward and that automation keeps Jira up to date across connected tools. That is a first-party automation capability, but the evidence is high-level marketing copy and never describes how trigger-and-action rules are built. missing for 10: documentation of the trigger/condition/action rule builder, catalog of available triggers and actions, depth of non-AI rule authoring, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can build trigger-and-action automation rules to eliminate repetitive manual steps

citations.quote: Use Rovo AI to create custom automations to keep your status up to date - from automated reminders to rules that move work forward.
Connect your tools to any Jira workflow with automation. Whether your team is using Bitbucket, Slack, or any other tool, automation keeps Jira up to date, so you don't have to.
Breakdown big ideas into actionable tasks and automatically assign them to the right person with Rovo AI.
